description: This file declares an interface class IFactories within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. The class provides factory methods for creating proxies to various Web-related objects such as Request, Response, FileBody, and JSONRPC. It includes mechanisms for singleton-like access and checks for availability, along with deprecated type aliases for WorkerPool and Factories.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface defining factory methods for creating web request/response and related objects. It supports singleton access, assignment, and availability checking.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns an instance to the singleton reference.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IFactories instance is available.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Request object.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Response object.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::FileBody object.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::JSONBodyType<Core::JSONRPC::Message> object.
